title: A serum proteomics-based predictive model for steroid-resistant immune checkpoint inhibitor associated myocarditis.
snippet: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis (ICIAM) is one of the immune-related adverse events (irAEs) with low incidence but extremely high mortality.
